about: Laws that were repealed and replaced. When Ask retrieves a section of an old law AND a section of its replacement, it answers from the current law and names the old section as 'previously ...' (switch: currentLaw in chat-tuning.json). `old` and `new` are the start of the Act title in lower case; `label` is how the replacement is named to the reader. Add a pair here to cover another repealed law; no code change.
